name: Denim Tsunami
iocPatterns: Zero-day exploits (Chrome, Android, Windows, Adobe Reader)
keyCapabilities: Credential harvesting from memory and system processes
recommendedActions: Implement rapid patching for Adobe products and Microsoft Windows core components.
Deploy EDR signatures specifically designed to identify Corelump and Jumplump artifacts.
Monitor network traffic for high-volume or unusual data transfers involving image files (potential steganography).
Monitor system logs for unauthorized modifications to the WDigest registry key.
Enable strict hardware protections for LSASS memory access to prevent credential dumping.
Enforce multi-factor authentication (MFA) for all external and internal remote access points.
Implement policies to block execution of Office macros and other unusual script runners like PowerShell from non-standard sources.
Block or alert on connections to known malicious C2 infrastructure associated with DSIRF.
Perform regular audits of signed certificate usage within corporate systems to identify rogue certifications.
campaignsText: Denim Tsunami (formerly KNOTWEED) maintains a steady operation tailored to high-end surveillance and data theft for private clients. Their campaign patterns show heavy reliance on zero-day exploitation—such as CVE-2022-22047 and various Adobe Reader vulnerabilities—to gain initial access in sophisticated environments. The group has been observed during the 2021-2023 period utilizing multi-stage infection chains where loaders like Jumplump deliver core payloads like Corelump. Their operation is characterized by high technical sophistication, frequently incorporating custom decryption routines and hidden system paths to maintain persistent and stealthy communication with command centers.
description: Denim Tsunami is a sophisticated Austrian-based private sector offensive actor (PSOA) that provides high-end surveillance and access-as-a-service capabilities to third parties. The group utilizes advanced zero-day exploits, custom malware suites like Subzero, and sophisticated evasion techniques to target high-value targets in Europe and Central America.
goals: Denim Tsunami functions as a commercial espionage provider, targeting high-value entities within the financial services, energy, defense, and government sectors. Their target operations are specifically concentrated in Europe and Central America, with an emphasis on gathering strategic intelligence for their clients. The actor's strategy focuses on identifying targets that require deep persistent access, such as law firms and consulting agencies, where information is highly sensitive.
